answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The protection comes from the fact that every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, so flooding the jury floods the attacker with its own cost. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be. Consider a mesa as the anchor of the cost.
